strings.subtitle: — Isibhubhisi sefayela —
strings.dnd_unavailable: Ukuhudula nokudonsa akutholakali. Sebenzisa inkinobho engezansi.
strings.shred_button: B H U B H I S A
strings.ssd_warning:
Isexwayiso! Ku-SSD indlela yokubhala phezu akuginisekisi ukubhujiswa ngenxa ye-TRIM.
Uhlelo lwe-HDD.
strings.confirm_text:
Ifayela elithi "{name}" lizobhalwa phezu futhi lisuswe.

Qhubeka?
strings.confirm_lnk_text:
This is a shortcut (.lnk). Only the shortcut itself will be destroyed.

The target file it points to will remain intact.

Continue?
strings.drive_remote_warning:
This is a network drive (\\server\share).
Sector overwrite does not guarantee destruction — the server may have snapshots, deduplication or CoW.

Continue?
strings.drive_removable_warning:
This is a removable drive (USB stick / external HDD).
The controller may keep old blocks in reserve.

Continue?
strings.report_limits:
• Imifudlana yedatha ehlukile ye-NTFS (ADS) ayicutshungulwa.
• Ijenali ye-USN ayihlanjululwa.
• Amakhophi ethunzi nokuvumelanisa kwefu
  (OneDrive njll.) akuthinteki.
strings.status_full: Okuqukethwe kubhalwe phezu ngokugcwele ngamaqanda. Ukubuyisela akunakwenzeka — amathuluzi azobona amaqanda kuphela.
strings.status_fast: Ikhanda, umsila nemigqa engu-4 MB kubhalwe phezu. Okunye akuthintekile, kodwa ngenxa yezikhala ukubuyisela okugcwele ngamathuluzi omsebenzisi akunakwenzeka. Emadokhumentini ayimfihlo sebenzisa imodi EGCOWELE.
strings.status_empty: Ifayela lalingenalutho, ukubhala phezu kwakungadingeki. Lasuswa.
strings.error_permission: Ayikwazi ukufinyelela ifayela. Kungase kuvuliwe kolunye uhlelo. Vala bese uzama futhi.
strings.error_is_symlink: Lena yisixhumanisi somfanekiso. Izixhumanisi azikwazi ukubhujiswa — ifayela elihlosiwe lizohlala liphelele.
strings.error_reparse: Leli yifayela lesikhala (OneDrive noma okufanayo). Idatha yalo isefini, hhayi kudiski — akukho lutho lokubhubhisa lapha.
strings.error_not_file: Leli akulona ifayela (ifolda noma okunye). Donsa ifayela.
strings.error_hardlinks: Leli fayela linamanye amaxhumanisi aqinile ({n} wonke). Amaxhumanisi aqinile awanawo oyinhloko — wonke amagama ayalingana. Uma ubhubhisa ngomzila wamanje, idatha izobhalwa phezu futhi inqunywe ibe ngama-byte angu-32, kodwa okusele kuzohlala kufinyeleleka ngamanye amaxhumanisi. Susa wonke amaxhumanisi kuqala.
strings.error_compressed:
Ifayela licindezelwe, lishifriwe noma lincane. Ukubhala phezu ngamaqanda akuqinisekisi ukubhujiswa kwedatha endala ngoba i-NTFS iyigcina ngendlela ehlukile.

Susa isici: chofoza kwesokudla → Izici → Okuthuthukile → susa uphawu lwe-"Cindezela" kanye/noma "Shifra". Bese ugijima i-SHREDDER futhi.
